text:
Lena Park: Quick non-work question — if you could have one useless but delightful superpower for a day, what would it be? (purely aesthetic/annoying powers allowed) :smile:
Tomás: I want the ability to always find the matching sock. Life-changing but worthless in ROI terms. :socks:
Ayesha: Make any elevator play your theme song on arrival. Instant drama. :notes:
Vikram: Teleportation but only to the nearest coffee shop that serves cold brew. Not helpful except mornings. :coffee:
Cleo: Ability to make any plant in the office bloom for 10 seconds on command. Office morale booster. :seedling:
Maggie: My pick: perfectly refilled stapler at the moment you need it. Small, holy grail. :stapler: (yes I hoard staples)
Tomás: also, invisible but only while you hum 'Baby Shark' quietly. :joy:
Lena Park: @OpsBot can you add 'bloom on demand' to the office perks wishlist? :eyes:
OpsBot: /ticket created: #1234 - 'Biweekly Petal Deliveries' (bot voice) :robot_face:
Ayesha: we should have a poll. I'd vouch for elevator theme song. :raised_hands:
Vikram: Poll results in my heart: matching socks 1st, elevator themes 2nd.
Cleo: Bonus: write a tiny 'power spec' for yours:
```
name: BloomBurst
duration: 10s
cooldown: 8h
effect: morale++
``` :sparkles:
Maggie: omg that's adorable. Also, who wants to be on the 'stapler maintenance' squad? :handshake:
Lena Park: I'll volunteer for early mornings. :coffee: Thanks for the smiles y'all — feels like a Friday already. :party_parrot:
